services.name: Cheer Camp
services.desc: Ta Da All Stars is our intramural gymnastics team program designed for athletes who are ready for more challenge, more skill development, and more opportunities to shine. Created specifically for gymnasts looking for the next step from recreational classes, All-Stars introduces athletes to team training, routines, performance opportunities, and local competition in a fun, supportive environment. Unlike traditional competitive gymnastics, Ta Da All-Stars focuses on athlete growth, confidence, teamwork, and a positive team experience while maintaining the flexibility and culture families love about Ta Da.
